SAC v396 Live Trading System

Overview

This is a live trading system for Bitcoin/JPY using the SAC v396 model. The system implements automated trading with risk management and monitoring capabilities.

Features

  • Multi-Algorithm Support: Supports both PPO and SAC models

  • Multi-Venue Support: Coincheck and BitFlyer exchanges

  • SAC Model Integration: Uses the trained SAC v396 model for trading decisions

  • Continuous to Discrete Action Conversion: Converts SAC’s continuous actions to discrete trading actions (HOLD/BUY/SELL)

  • Flexible Risk Management: Configurable risk limits (disabled by default as requested)

  • Dry Run Mode: Test the system without real trades

  • Comprehensive Logging: Detailed logging for monitoring and debugging

  • Zaif Removed: Zaif support removed due to API issues

Prerequisites

  • Python 3.11

  • Required packages (see requirements.txt)

  • Trained SAC v396 model (checkpoints/sac_session/sac_v396_50k_final.zip)

  • Model configuration (configs/sac_v396_optimized.json)

Installation

  1. Activate the Python 3.11 environment:

    venv311\Scripts\activate

  2. Install dependencies:

    pip install -r requirements.txt

Usage

Dry Run (Recommended for Testing)

# SAC model on Coincheck
python ztb/trading/live_trade.py --model-path checkpoints/sac_session/sac_v396_50k_final.zip --algorithm sac --venue coincheck --dry-run --duration-hours 1

# PPO model on BitFlyer
python ztb/trading/live_trade.py --model-path checkpoints/ppo_session/ppo_model.zip --algorithm ppo --venue bitflyer --dry-run --duration-hours 1

Live Trading (Use with Caution - Risk Limits Disabled by Default)

# SAC model on Coincheck (live trading)
python ztb/trading/live_trade.py --model-path checkpoints/sac_session/sac_v396_50k_final.zip --algorithm sac --venue coincheck --dry-run false --duration-hours 24

# PPO model on BitFlyer (live trading)
python ztb/trading/live_trade.py --model-path checkpoints/ppo_session/ppo_model.zip --algorithm ppo --venue bitflyer --dry-run false --duration-hours 24

Command Line Options

  • --model-path: Path to trained model (.zip) [required]

  • --algorithm: Algorithm type (ppo or sac) [default: ppo]

  • --venue: Trading venue (coincheck or bitflyer) [default: coincheck]

  • --duration-hours: Trading duration in hours (default: 1)

  • --disable-risk-limits: Disable all risk limits (default: True - as requested)

  • --dry-run: Enable dry run mode (default: True)

Risk Management

Important: Risk limits are disabled by default as per your request. The system operates without safety restrictions.

When risk limits are enabled (--disable-risk-limits false):

  • Daily loss limits

  • Hourly trade limits

  • Emergency stop on low balance

  • Position size limits

Architecture

Core Components

  • LiveTrader: Main trading class supporting PPO/SAC and multiple venues

  • Model Loading: Loads PPO, MaskablePPO, or SAC models

  • Environment: Trading environment for observation generation

  • Action Conversion: Converts continuous SAC actions to discrete trades

  • Exchange Adapters: Coincheck and BitFlyer API integration

  • Risk Manager: Configurable risk limits (disabled by default)

Data Flow

  1. Fetch live BTC/JPY data from selected exchange

  2. Generate observation using trading environment

  3. Model predicts action (continuous for SAC, discrete for PPO)

  4. Convert to discrete action if needed

  5. Check risk limits (if enabled)

  6. Execute trade if safe

  7. Log results and repeat

Exchange Configuration

Coincheck

  • API Keys: COINCHECK_API_KEY, COINCHECK_API_SECRET

  • Base URL: https://coincheck.com/api

  • Rate Limit: 300 requests/minute

BitFlyer

  • API Keys: BITFLYER_API_KEY, BITFLYER_API_SECRET

  • Base URL: https://api.bitflyer.com

  • Rate Limit: 500 requests/minute

Monitoring

  • Logs are written to logs/live_trading_*.log

  • Monitor balance, position, and trade frequency

  • Check for risk limit violations (if enabled)

  • Review action distributions

Backtesting

Before live trading, validate with backtesting:

python scripts/evaluation/backtest_sac_v396.py --max-steps 1000

Expected results for v396:

  • Total Return: ~2-5%

  • Sharpe Ratio: >0.5

  • Win Rate: ~45-55%

  • HOLD: ~89%

  • BUY/SELL: ~5.5% each

Troubleshooting

Common Issues

  1. Model Loading Failed: Check model path and algorithm type

  2. Exchange API Error: Verify API credentials and venue selection

  3. No Trades Executed: Check dry-run mode and risk limits

  4. Import Errors: Ensure PYTHONPATH is set correctly

Logs Analysis

Check logs for:

  • Model loading confirmation

  • Exchange adapter initialization

  • Action predictions and conversions

  • Trade executions

  • Error messages

Future Improvements

  • Real-time dashboard for monitoring

  • Advanced risk management (VaR, drawdown limits)

  • Multi-asset support

  • Automated model switching

  • Performance analytics
